metadataV2.tagline: Turn the sources you follow into a podcast made just for you
metadataV2.longDescription: Every morning it condenses the sources you subscribe to into one audio briefing you can finish on your commute. This version is a static UI demo: data is built in and nothing goes online; subscription digesting, real audio and the global mini player arrive in a later release.
